rows.result: 既存の初期値・設定遷移テストを再実行。歪みの3100キューは背景取得に必要なまま。
rows.remaining_requirement: URP separately schedules distortion; a shader-only GrabPass is invoked at its material queue.
rows.next_acceptance: Preserve transparent-background capture at the original queue without changing other transparent ordering.

rows.result: 標準GUID・Fire001直接利用をSDKで再検証。任意の独自URPシェーダーを無変換では実行できない。
rows.remaining_requirement: A shader GUID cannot safely identify both original URP code and a different Built-in implementation in one import.
rows.next_acceptance: Exercise optimized/custom GUID bundles and original-source collision imports; preserve executable shader references automatically.

rows.result: 全描画回帰とSDK/AAOの重なりを再検証。heal02の同順位ソートは過去の反例として保持。
rows.remaining_requirement: Stable ordering of equal queue/distance/sorting keys belongs to each engine renderer, beyond an individual fragment shader.
rows.next_acceptance: Reproduce heal02 tied-key ordering against original and find a deterministic, no-conversion ordering rule.

rows.result: 曲面・負スケール・符号を含む既存回帰を再実行。依頼済みの有限値ガードを維持。
rows.remaining_requirement: The requested finite 1e-4 guard is intentionally different from original singular arithmetic.
rows.next_acceptance: Analyze the guarded denominator with signed near-singularity GPU inputs and preserve finite outputs.

rows.result: 本家数式との35描画比較で20失敗を再現し修正。正投影・斜交・負強度・微小強度が一致。
rows.remaining_requirement: A shader cannot recover opaque/transparent geometry absent from the world camera depth texture.
rows.next_acceptance: Compare perspective/orthographic/oblique depth linearization, signed intensity and world-provided depth coverage.

rows.result: 15件の左右眼配列描画と最悪条件のコンパイルを再検証。実HMDは未実施。
rows.remaining_requirement: Texture-array simulation and compilation do not prove the real XR runtime path.
rows.next_acceptance: Run actual PCVR eyes/mirror/depth with the SDK/AAO-built avatar on a physical headset.

rows.result: 両Litの既存BRDF回帰を再実行。世界のライト割当の差は数式の変更では解消できない。
rows.remaining_requirement: Final workflow output still consumes different engine light/probe assignments.
rows.next_acceptance: Extend original direct BRDF captures across punctual light attenuation and mixed probe inputs.

rows.result: 既存の2D/Array/3D表面マップ描画とSDKの素材保持を再検証。最終照明入力の差は残る。
rows.remaining_requirement: Map sampling is preserved; complete surface output depends on independently approximate scene lighting.
rows.next_acceptance: Extend real imported texture-format/filter/mip and mixed-light surface captures.

rows.result: 既存ライト回帰を再実行。アバターへ届かないライト一覧から本家の主光源を再選択できない。
rows.remaining_requirement: Built-in and URP select and bind main lights differently; avatars do not own the scene light list.
rows.next_acceptance: Reproduce no-directional, several-directional and importance changes with original light selection.

rows.result: ForwardAdd・UI補助・影の回帰を再実行。エンジンによるライト制限・Cookie入力の差は残る。
rows.remaining_requirement: ForwardAdd scheduling/attenuation differs from URP and a finite single-pass Canvas list omits shadows/cookies.
rows.next_acceptance: Compare pixel-light limits, importance, shadows/cookies and blended order for dense local lights.

rows.result: 既存の受影・無効化・組合せを再検証。世界のシャドウアトラスとPCFの完全置換は未実装。
rows.remaining_requirement: The Built-in shadow atlas, bias and cascade selection cannot be replaced by an avatar shader alone.
rows.next_acceptance: Compare bias, cascade boundaries, PCF footprints and mixed lights using actual world shadow inputs.

rows.result: 局所の赤いSHが全体の反射光に混入する差を再現。任意カメラ補助で分離しFlat/Trilight/Skyboxと状態復元を検証。VRCの無スクリプト経路では差が残る。
rows.remaining_requirement: Global ambient-probe DC is not separately supplied to the scriptless avatar shader.
rows.next_acceptance: Reproduce separate renderer and global SH DC with local/custom probes; assess an optional world/camera binder.

rows.result: 既存の反射・粗さ回帰を再実行。今回の全体環境光補助はエンジンの反射プローブ選択は変更しない。
rows.remaining_requirement: Engine probe selection/capture differs; NOVA itself does not provide blending/box-projection variants.
rows.next_acceptance: Compare probe assignment, capture updates and fallback under the same moving renderer.

rows.result: 明示パスの描画とEditor API回帰を再実行。ネイティブ画面の選択イベントは新規検証していない。
rows.remaining_requirement: Explicit pass drawing already works; native Editor invocation is a separate integration contract.
rows.next_acceptance: Automate actual Editor picking/selection callbacks in both editors and compare IDs.

rows.result: 既存Caster描画・コンパイルを再実行。世界側バイアス・アトラス差は残る。
rows.remaining_requirement: World-owned shadow scheduling/atlas conventions differ.
rows.next_acceptance: Capture equivalent caster bias and cube/directional variants in original and Built-in.

rows.result: 既存明示パスとクリップ回帰を再実行。自動深度生成がShadowCasterを用いる仕様は変えない。
rows.remaining_requirement: Built-in auto-depth uses ShadowCaster; an explicit DepthOnly pass is not an automatically scheduled URP prepass.
rows.next_acceptance: Exercise actual camera depth inclusion and original caster-disabled depth-only materials.

rows.result: カメラ補助・左右眼・生成シェーダーの回帰を再実行。物理深度の計算は今回のSoftParticles修正から分離した。
rows.remaining_requirement: NOVA dedicated texture is implemented, but does not own or replace world depth normals.
rows.next_acceptance: Compare native consumer integration including encoding, scheduling and world occlusion.

rows.result: 既存ForwardAdd/Canvas代替の回帰を再実行。クラスタ型描画基盤は今回の承認計画の対象外。
rows.remaining_requirement: No tiled/clustered renderer is shipped; ForwardAdd is not algorithm/API-compatible Forward+.
rows.next_acceptance: Evaluate bounded multi-light alternatives with matched visible light sets and GPU cost.

rows.result: 既存LPPV空間読み取りの回帰を再実行。APVのファイル形式・ストリーミングは承認計画の対象外。
rows.remaining_requirement: LPPV does not implement APV placement, data formats, streaming or scenarios; world data is required.
rows.next_acceptance: Study an optional data adapter with actual APV probe/scenario fixtures and cost limits.

rows.result: D3Dの座標変換が恒等の範囲を維持。実XRランタイムの密度制御は未検証。
rows.remaining_requirement: D3D remapping is identity, but shader tests cannot establish runtime density-control compatibility.
rows.next_acceptance: Verify physical Windows XR runtime VRS plus per-eye UV/depth behavior.

rows.result: 8表示とビルド時除去の回帰を再実行。URPデバッグサービスの型や呼出し互換は提供しない。
rows.remaining_requirement: The implemented eight views use a Built-in Editor helper; URP debug service/API is absent.
rows.next_acceptance: Inventory remaining original debug views and actual activation/stripping semantics.

rows.result: 既存Canvas・Mask・光源選択の回帰を再実行。Overlay実画面・追加光の影/Cookieは未解消。
rows.remaining_requirement: The optional eight-light list has no shadow atlas/cookie manager; real Canvas/custom runtime components are outside VRC avatar scope.
rows.next_acceptance: Capture Overlay pixels and compare shadow/cookie cases, light selection and all Canvas modes.

rows.result: 既存実行可能APIとカメラ回帰を再実行。URP型を引数にするAPIは無依存パッケージの制約と両立しない。
rows.remaining_requirement: Executable Built-in APIs preserve selected call forms but cannot implement URP base classes/parameters without URP.
rows.next_acceptance: Compare engine callback/lifecycle usage in real consuming projects, including camera stacking.

rows.result: SDK/AAO後のゼロ強度重なり・鏡を再検証。非ゼロ歪みの全物体加算と8x/9x差は残る。
rows.remaining_requirement: A shared GrabPass lacks a per-camera additive offset texture; extra copies or rendering have real cost. Inline8 vs forced9 remains.
rows.next_acceptance: Use nonzero overlapping distortion and sampler-sharing experiments to evaluate a low-cost exact accumulator.

rows.result: ソフト粒子の計算を修正し既存可視性回帰を再実行。世界の深度にない遮蔽物は復元できない。
rows.remaining_requirement: Missing world camera depth cannot be reconstructed from only the avatar surface.
rows.next_acceptance: Compare world transparent-depth coverage and camera-resolved depth tests across MSAA modes.

rows.result: 既存ネスト/反射/Preview回帰を再実行。実XR・Editorの統合イベント網羅ではない。
rows.remaining_requirement: Nested mono Game/Reflection/Preview now pass; unsupported compositor camera types still select the shader fallback.
rows.next_acceptance: Extend the fixed nested-camera path to actual XR/SceneView and callback-order integrations.

rows.result: 48生成名・パス保持除去・コンパイルの回帰を再実行。パスの自動呼出しは各エンジンのまま。
rows.remaining_requirement: Pass presence/strip flags work; pipeline invocation differences remain.
rows.next_acceptance: Test retained generated passes through native depth/selection consumer entry points.

rows.result: 既存のパッケージ参照・出力移動テストを再実行。元パッケージ移動時の参照修復は未実装。
rows.remaining_requirement: Previously generated shaders contain include paths; preserving legacy helper signatures does not repair moved package paths.
rows.next_acceptance: Evaluate stable include identifiers for generated assets moved between package installations.

rows.result: Unity 2022/6・D3D11/12・SDK/AAOを再検証。別GPU・PCVR実機は未検証。
rows.remaining_requirement: Windows D3D coverage cannot establish every Unity GPU/platform behavior.
rows.next_acceptance: Repeat rendering, sampler, shader-budget and physical XR checks on additional GPUs/backends.
